name: Bernardo
message: I have some news for you, old friend.

name: Marcellus
message: Ah. War business? When'll you be back?

name: Bernardo
message: No. It's got nothing to do with that. This is a... personal endeavor.

name: Bernardo
message: I don't know when—or if—I'll return.

name: Bernardo
message: That's why I wanted to speak with you. They need someone capable and seasoned to lead them.

name: Bernardo
message: They need you, Marcellus. There's no man I trust more. And now the King will be relying on you, too.

name: Marcellus
message: I... knew in my heart th'day would come when you'd leave eventually. Jus' never thought it'd be like this. So sudden.

name: Bernardo
message: I'm sorry, my friend. I truly am.

name: Bernardo
message: I cannot speak of my reasons. But trust that I do this now to cause as little pain to everyone here as possible. Including myself.

name: Marcellus
message: T-then... it must be the right thing. Yer a sharp man, Captain. I jus' wish you well. I hope yer safe.

name: Bernardo
message: When I depart, I'd appreciate it if you didn't tell anyone where I went.
